description: A balanced article with six H1 sections, enough depth for explanation and implementation guidance.
writing_guidance: Develop the topic in a logical sequence, vary the section rhythm, and keep every section useful to the reader's decision or task.

sections.purpose: Introduce the reader's situation and the article's practical outcome.
sections.heading_instruction: Use the article title as the first heading.
sections.content_instruction: Establish relevance and preview the useful ground the article will cover.

sections.purpose: Define the topic and establish the essential background.
sections.content_instruction: Explain terminology, context, and why the subject matters.

sections.purpose: Explain the major factors the reader should evaluate.
sections.content_instruction: Cover meaningful tradeoffs, requirements, or decision criteria.

sections.purpose: Present a practical method, framework, or sequence.
sections.content_instruction: Give concrete steps or recommendations without padding.

sections.purpose: Help the reader avoid predictable mistakes and recognize success.
sections.heading_instruction: Use a heading about risks, checks, or measurement.
sections.content_instruction: Explain common failure points, quality checks, or meaningful outcomes.

sections.purpose: Bring the guidance together and recommend a relevant next step.
sections.content_instruction: Summarize the decision or action without repeating the full article.
